subject: Ahead of renewal: capacity surge & isolated clusters request
messages:
From: Julia Morse <julia.morse@medatech.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ahead of renewal: capacity surge & isolated clusters request

Hi Sergio / Kimberly,

We're coming up on our renewal (end of November) and need to firm up a plan for two things: a short-term surge to cover a pilot Q1 analytics push, and a longer-term isolation carveout for PHI workloads. High-level asks: 

- Add two isolated clusters in our VPC (us-west1) dedicated to PHI and inference workloads (no tenant sharing).
- One standby cluster for failover (warm) that can be spun up during maintenance windows.
- Proposal for a 24-month term option with committed capacity pricing; prefer pricing that includes a predictable burst allowance for the first 90 days.
- Confirmation of fallbacks: ability to route selected requests to hosted Redwood if on-prem capacity is degraded.

I've attached our capacity matrix and a short compliance note. Can we get a feasibility check + rough pricing and an expected timeline for provisioning? We have an executive renewal call on Nov 9, so aiming to have a proposal before then.

Thanks,
Julia Morse
Director of IT, MedaTech Solutions
[julia.morse@medatech.com]

[Attachment: medatech_capacity_matrix.xlsx]
[Attachment: compliance_requirements.pdf]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morse <julia.morse@medatech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ahead of renewal: capacity surge & isolated clusters request

Hi Julia — thanks for the detail and the attachments. We're confident we can support a staged approach that meets both the surge and the isolation requirements. Early thoughts / next steps: 

1) Cluster "fission" approach: create two new isolated clusters (inference-isolated, analytics-isolated) plus a warm standby cluster that is kept updated with images and KV cache sync. Keeps PHI workloads physically isolated at the cluster level.

2) Fallback routing: we can implement request-level routing rules that direct traffic to Redwood hosted for non-sensitive endpoints during failover; PHI endpoints would fail closed unless you opt into encrypted-hosted routing with strict contract terms.

3) Timeline: if we start procurement this week, infra can provision two isolated clusters + standby in ~4–6 weeks (subject to IP whitelisting and network approvals). We can front-load a 90-day burst pool for the first quarter.

Action items: 
- Kimberly / Monica: can you confirm feasibility (network, KMS/HSM requirements) and put together a pricing sketch and contract amendment language?
- Julia: share any internal firewall/contact ops for IP peering and VPN setup.

I'll pull in the Dedicated ops runbook and a sample amendment.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment references will follow]

--

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ahead of renewal: capacity surge & isolated clusters request

Sergio / team,

Feasibility review from infra/security: we can support the requested topology with the following constraints and recommendations: 

- Provisioning: two isolated clusters + one warm standby is fine; clusters will be backed by dedicated node pools and separate VPC subnets. Estimate: 4–6 weeks once we have network peering and KMS ok.
- KMS/HSM: for PHI workloads we recommend customer-managed KMS (customer key in CMK) and HSM integration for key signing; we will need your KMS ARN and contact for key rotation policy.
- SLA implications: isolated clusters are included under Dedicated SLA; warm standby will not be counted as active capacity for throughput billing but will incur a standby fee (approx 20% of a full cluster).
- Pricing: sketch attached — baseline + standby + 90-day burst pool. We recommend a 12-month committed term with an option to extend to 24 months at a pre-agreed uplift to keep downside flexibility.

Attachments: topology_v1.png (net topology), pricing_summary.csv

Proposed next steps: 
- Sergio: confirm the term preference (12 vs 24-month).
- Julia: approval to start network peering paperwork (we'll send a checklist).
- Monica: prepare a draft amendment for the renewal that includes the standby clause and burst pool.

Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: topology_v1.png]
[Attachment: pricing_summary.csv]

Sergio / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming we accept the proposed topology and the standby clause. A few clarifications before we engage legal: 

- Term: we'll proceed with a 24-month committed term if we can lock in the burst pool pricing for the first 90 days (no price uplift during the first quarter).
- KMS: we will provide a KMS ARN and a contact for our security team this week.
- Timeline: we need the two isolated clusters provisioned and network-peered by Dec 20 (so we can validate before the Jan pilot).

Please prepare the contract amendment & DocuSign for approval. Our procurement will route the DocuSign link once it's ready — here is a placeholder for the contract envelope.
